lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately five vertical columns and three horizontal rows within the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating grid-like anchor nodes where blob intensity is highest at the vertical stripe centerlines.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical pixel gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of small, high-luminance pixel clusters that are more randomly distributed compared to the structured grid pattern on the main body.
